  1. [1]2026

    Skip What You Can Predict: Predictive Repositioning for Policy Optimization for Efficient LLM Training

    I. N. Swapnil, A. Saha, T. Zahra, T. A. Khan, M. A. Haque, & S.-N. Lim

    Preprint · Submitted to ICLR 2027

    ARXIVPDF
    ABS

    PrePO extrapolates from two observed same-batch optimizer updates to a farther point on the trajectory, then corrects it. The method matches baseline performance with fewer optimization steps and less wall-clock time; gains also carry over to supervised fine-tuning.

  2. [2]2025

    Trans-SPAnet: A Unified Transformer–CNN Architecture with Enhanced Boundary Optimization for Polyp Segmentation

    IEEE International Conference on Biomedical Engineering, Computer and Information Technology for Health (BECITHCON 2025)

    ABS

    A hybrid CNN–Transformer for polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images. Spatial-context preservation blocks retain fine detail, a Transformer decoder models long-range context, and boundary-aware optimization sharpens polyp contours to improve on CNN-only baselines.
